candidates.summary: Anthropic posted remarks from CEO Dario Amodei on the company's initial public offering. The post begins: 'My co-founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the...'
Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch congratulated Anthropic on 'a generational IPO' and on holding and deepening its lead on models.
Theo says 'We now know what this looks like. It's called Gemini 4 Neon for some reason', with an attached link.

Theo reports PrimeIntellect appears to have been compromised in a 'very strange way'. He says there are no public comms from them yet, and that OpenRouter disclosed it to affected users, including him.

Perplexity's Aravind Srinivas shared research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. 'Brain', which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills from your past sessions; an improvement agent reads the full session trajectories.

Perplexity launched its Context API yesterday. Following feedback from Tobi, it shipped decision models that check fetched content for prompt injection and other filtering, described as a 'safe fetch for agents' with scores on custom criteria.

Guillermo Rauch says Vercel Board has no heavyweight or opinionated UI: 'It's infra not product', likening it to 'headless Slack' for agents, where you generate and deploy a custom 'factory interface' per use case.
a16z posted that Nick Bostrom says delaying superintelligence carries risks of its own, as each year of delay could postpone medical breakthroughs.
